item.title: 250 Years of Business Brew: From Rented Pineapples to Trillionaire Rockets
item.description:
How business shaped the US...
Good morning. The US turned 250 yesterday, which, other than making us wonder how we’d explain the existence of Hawk Tuah to George Washington, has got us thinking about the fascinating evolution of business in America. How’d we go from an agrarian society to one with Elon Musk and SpaceX? What are the most important US companies in history, and what will be the most important moving forward? Those questions and more are answered in today’s special edition delving into 250 years of American biz.
https://www.morningbrew.com/issues/250-years-of-business-brew

item.description:

Greetings. Did you know that today is the real Independence Day? The Continental Congress formally declared freedom from Great Britain on July 2, 1776, but approved the Declaration of Independence two days later. John Adams was so sure that July 2 would be the date of the holiday that he wrote, “It ought to be solemnized with Pomp and Parade, with Shews, Games, Sports, Guns, Bells, Bonfires, and Illuminations.”
